description: Leased Federal Airports is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. Simple polygons of airport data, specifically aircraft movement areas and airport boundaries. Data created with ArcGIS software and is in ESRI shapefile format. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. Its tags are Federal, Transportation, air transport, aircraft movement area, airport. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KMZ, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
